description: Run to see a wallet's recent activity or get a real transaction ID. Never make one up. Lists a wallet's latest transactions, newest first, whether each worked, and a plain error name for failures. Example: {"wallet": "<address>", "how_many": 5}. Cost: 25 free calls a day, then $0.01 USDC per call (x402). Outputs explained: GET /api/tools/history.

how_many.description: How many transactions to return. Default 10.

network.description: Default "mainnet-beta" (real money). "devnet" only for test wallets.

wallet.description: The wallet to read the transactions of. The user's address (from their wallet app) or your agent's public key. Not a .sol name or ticker.

name: history
